themes.evidence: We work together with customers and understand that everyone has a role in providing the best solution.
We are focused on our own personal safety as well as the safety of others.
We are resourceful. We are innovative and strive to apply the right technology and solution every time.

We combine technology, services and execution expertise to assist our customers with hydrocarbons location, geological data management, drilling and formation evaluation, well construction and completion, and production optimization throughout the life of their asset.
We deliver what we promise. We believe the quality of our service defines who we are.
How our strategy for sustainability serves as the cornerstone of our operations and our future.
We are committed to inclusion across race, gender, nationality, religion, identity, experience, and any other unique attribute.
Our dedicated executives have the knowledge and experience to deliver successful results.

linguistic_shift: Our values guide us in everything we do, underpinning how we relate to each other and everyone with whom we interact.
analyst_notes: The page's tone remains consistent, but the emphasis on collaboration and sustainability is highlighted more explicitly.
